core_method_problem.description: Complete the preserved Batch 3 implementation against the approved 2005-based windows, including pseudo-stress validation, six required figures, and all remaining acceptance criteria.

limitations: Historical reporting-detail changes and shorter Mortgage-NCO coverage may remain only if verified against official FFIEC definitions.
Total NPL may remain only as a documented bank-level fallback, not a segment NPL metric.
One directly verified source-filing inconsistency may remain as an explicit exception.
The 100-observation source audit is sample evidence rather than exhaustive validation.
Batch 3 uses the approved 2005-based expanding windows and includes all three pseudo-stress windows plus six figures.
Bayesian posterior forecasts are excluded under the documented environment fallback; diagnostics contain no sampled posterior results.

router.notes: Batch 3 worker completed local validation: approved OOS windows, pseudo-stress outputs, six figures, and full test suite. Commit/push this checkpoint before any independent stage review.
